mapper.select: SELECT minihompy_id FROM minihompy WHERE user_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_log (visitor_id, minihompy_id, visited_at) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{minihompyId}, #{visitedAt}) ON CONFLICT (minihompy_id, visitor_id, (visited_at::date)) WHERE visitor_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log v JOIN minihompy m ON m.minihompy_id = v.minihompy_id WHERE m.user_id = #{ownerId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.visited_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log v JOIN minihompy m ON m.minihompy_id = v.minihompy_id WHERE m.user_id = #{ownerId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT u.nickname, visitor_profile.media_url AS profile_image_url, v.visited_at FROM visit_log v JOIN minihompy m ON m.minihompy_id = v.minihompy_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = v.visitor_id LEFT JOIN media visitor_profile ON visitor_profile.target_type = 'PROFILE' AND visitor_profile.target_id = v.visitor_id AND visitor_profile.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE m.user_id = #{ownerId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.visited_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
